content.title: Jobs
content.summary: The City of Arvada utilizes Workday as its jobs portal, where individuals can view and apply for various positions, including those in the Arvada Police Department. The city has been recognized as a Top Workplace and offers competitive salaries along with a comprehensive benefits package. For assistance with applications or job notifications, applicants can contact the Human Resources Department at 720-898-7555 or via email.

## [Voted Top Workplace for 2024!](https://topworkplaces.com/company/city-of-arvada/)

We have consistently received Top Workplace awards since 2012. Most recently, we received USA Today's Top Workplaces Award.

## Application Help and Job Notifications

### Need Technical Assistance with Application?

If you experience any issues accessing your Workday account, please [email Arvada's Human Resources Department](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#e08e859788899285a0819296818481ce8f9287) or give us a call at [720-898-7555.](tel:7208987555)

### Want to Search for Jobs or Get Job Alerts?

Create your account on the [Official City of Arvada Jobs Portal](https://arvada.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/City_of_Arvada_External_Career_Site). Having an account gives you the ability to search for jobs, create a profile, and set up job alerts.

## Human Resources Overview

### Contact Information

**Notice to applicants and other Human Resources (HR) related needs:** City Facilities have limited visitor access. For a more immediate response, it is recommended you send us an email at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2b454e5c4342594e6b4a595d4a4f4a0544594c). If you have further questions about an open position, application status or need to schedule an appointment with our HR team, please call the human resources main line at 720-898-7555.

### Our Work Force

We establish and maintain an effective work force to meet the needs of the residents of Arvada. Our employees are dedicated to delivering superior services to enhance the lives of everyone in our community.

### Equal Employment Opportunity

Equal Employment Opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at the City of Arvada, where employment is based upon personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination because of race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital status, pregnancy, age, medical condition, handicap, or disability or any other protected characteristic as established by law.
